title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-93-24一模

items.zh: 直到医生偶然发现了这种抗病毒药物，人们才正真相信它的存在。
items.en: People didn’t genuinely believe in its existence until doctors found this antiviral drug by accident.

items.zh: 与我个人的成长经历相比，这个西北小村庄的发展更加令人感动。
items.en: Compared with my personal growth, the development of the small northwest village is more touching.

items.zh: 只要这项研究的结果能够应用于新技术的开发，我们的努力就会得到回报。
items.en: So long as the results of the research can be applied to the development of new technology, our efforts will pay off/be rewarded.

items.zh: 离职，不管是什么工作，是一个艰难的改变，即使对于那些期待退休的人来说也是如此。
items.en: No matter what job, leaving the position is a tough change, even for those looking forward to retirement.
